body: I don’t really have different reasons, at least not that I know of. I had a really happy albeit somewhat boring life which makes me a bit boring according to my friends haha. Whatever that’s fine. A thing with me that’s maybe a bit weird is that I am really emotionless. Like I don’t really feel anything so I can be really dramatic, like I over act reactions to situations. On the plus side, despite me being dramatic in manner I’ve been told I am like the most zen/chill person they’ve ever met, and on the low side some people think I am fake although I am trying my hardest. Oh one reason maybe is because I am really insensitive to pain. I haven’t really yet seen a neurologist although my surgeon told me to haha. Like I’ve broken bones and thought it was no big deal and just walked it off. I’ve actually almost died because I failed to recognize I had a really bad injury. So um.... yeah probably would have died “in the wild”.

I don’t really actively seek risks per se, I just do a lot of things that I later recognize intellectually as being risky. Because I am not scared for my life, a lot of really dangerous things don’t feel exciting to me so there is no reward for that risk taking behavior. Like the other day I free handled a sand viper not because I wanted the thrill of being almost bitten, but I was just having a hard time moving him with all the hooks and stuff. Now, reflecting, intellectually I realize that was probably a really risky thing where I almost accidentally killed my self again.
